title: Challenge #33: VQETape exact VQE compiler
lede: VQETape beats TensorCircuit-NG by 8.2% on a matched 100-step amortized objective and lowers host RSS, while warm runtime and device-memory superiority remain unmet.

blocks.text: Build an auto-evaluated VQE simulation harness that exceeds the TensorCircuit-NG baseline in time and space efficiency.
Joint search over representation, contraction path, reverse program, checkpoints, symmetry, optimizer, initialization, and ansatz growth.
PASS amortized objective (16.7781 s vs 18.2720 s) and host RSS; FAIL warm runtime (3.3785 ms best VQETape vs 2.6577 ms).

blocks.title: What is innovative
blocks.text: A differentiated contraction-program search plus exact physics-aware reductions and end-to-end ansatz/optimizer co-design, with negative results preserved.

blocks.title: Boundary
blocks.text: The literal warm-runtime and device-memory criteria are not met; formal N=32,L=16 Fig. 2 execution remains open.
